about: Cases across layers (docs/plan-improve-examples.md, 6.3), over the sample dataset. Built from templates, named by the tag tpl:<shape>; every reference finds something, less than its whole layer, and every condition changes its result. Batch 1 (ml01-ml28): three layers, two relations on the subject; batch 2 (ml29-ml68): two layers, one relation, every pair of layers; batch 3 (ml69-ml73): confirm only, three layers no tuning case combines (group 4).
